scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.format:check: prettier --check eslint.config.js .prettierrc package.json artifacts/clause-compass/src/App.tsx artifacts/clause-compass/src/index.css artifacts/clause-compass/src/pages/accessibility.tsx artifacts/clause-compass/src/pages/brief.tsx artifacts/clause-compass/src/pages/compare.tsx artifacts/clause-compass/src/pages/document.tsx e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @workspace/core run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
